items.q: So when I talked to Steve, he said oh, don't worry about a thing and he laughed and we all had a big laugh and he went and made arrangements with his people that I could stay there for a week

ctx.x: they're supposed to do. So I said, I can't go home, I don't have any money. Can't you send home for money? I said my mother is a widow and I'm trying to work my way here. Well, you've got to do something, and so they said you've got to get off the campus for a week.

So I told Captain Dryer and so he said don't worry, I think Steve has a big house, hell, his people will let you stay. So when I talked to Steve, he said oh, don't worry about a thing and he laughed and we all had a big laugh and he went and made arrangements with his people that I could stay there for a week and he went and told them that they were suspending me for a week, that I didn't do anything disgraceful but I had to be off the campus.
